# SanSha A Beauty Lounge — full site summary

## Business facts

- Business: SanSha A Beauty Lounge
- Website: https://sanshabeautylounge.com/ (apex canonical)
- Tagline: "Your Beauty, Your Canvas"
- Phone (call): 091-5839119 (+92 91 5839119, landline) — WhatsApp: +92 313 9333377
- Email: sansha.lounge@gmail.com
- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Address: Shop No. 4, Block A, Deans Hights, Phase 2, Hayatabad, Peshawar 25124, Pakistan
- Service area: Hayatabad and Peshawar, Pakistan
- Model: walk-in salon — clients come to the salon. No home service, no men's/barber service, no courses.
- Prices: no prices are published. Call or WhatsApp for today's price.
- Google rating: 3.9 stars from 92 Google reviews. The reviews page shows a selection of verbatim Google reviews with the reviewer's first name and "via Google".
- Socials: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/sanshaabeautylounge (2.9K followers) · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/SanshaAbeautylounge (3,297 followers) · TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@sanshaabeautylounge (920 followers, 142 videos)

## Services

- Bridal makeup — makeup with hairdo for barat, walima, nikah, mehndi and engagement functions. Book ahead in wedding season (October–February).
- Party makeup — makeup with hairdo for engagements, dinners and family events.
- Hair salon — women's haircuts, blow-dry, hair wash and styling for events.
- Keratin treatment — keratin and protein treatments for smooth, frizz-free hair; hair spa also listed.
- Hair colour — hair dye, balayage, streaks and highlights. Choose your shade first, then book.
- Laser hair removal — face, arms, legs and full body. Book a consultation on call or WhatsApp.
- Facials — whitening, organic and derma facials with skin polish.
- Waxing & threading — waxing for arms, legs, face and underarms; threading and eyebrow shaping.
- Manicure & pedicure — whitening manicure and pedicure with polish and nail care.

## What the salon does not offer

No medical aesthetics (no Botox, fillers, PRP or HydraFacial), no beautician courses, no men's salon or barber service, no at-home service. No prices are published on the site.
